title: Nemeda Agent Kit configuration pointer
description: Local .nemeda/agent-kit.link.json: names the shared drive that holds the workspace configuration (docs/drive-config-plan.md). Non-secret and identical on every machine.

sharedDrive.description: Shared drive (or synced library) that holds the configuration; the drive copy must declare the same drive.

path.description: Path of agent-kit.json inside the shared drive.
